fieldValues.value: Place composite-renderer dispatch in the view layer

Composite renderer choice is a presentation arrangement, not a property of a Field or Type. View ownership permits multiple legitimate presentations of the same records while retaining a portable precedence contract.
Composite renderer selection is owned by the view layer rather than Field or Type, so different views may present the same semantic records differently.

- Keep compositeRenderer on FieldGroup or the replacement Type.
- Put renderer selection on each instance.
- Allow only a repository-wide renderer choice.
Renderer declarations move to view capabilities and cannot be recovered from semantic Fields alone.
Review when renderer selection is proposed on a semantic definition or instance, or when view-level declarations cannot express a needed presentation.
